name: phaser
description: Phaser skill carrying only what changed from Phaser 3 to 4 and still gets written the v3 way: preFX/postFX and BitmapMask replaced by filters, setLighting, setTintFill reduced to a console error, Math.TAU corrected from π/2 to 2π, Geom.Point removed, roundPixels off by default, pipelines rewritten as render nodes; plus the scene.launch restart and three Arcade Physics footguns (two-sided collision masks, onFloor on dynamic bodies, drag under acceleration). Reads the lockfile before advising.
